_meta.purpose: Single source for every number and claim in the deck (docs/pitch/deck/index.html) and its content source (docs/pitch/deck-content.md). Edit the value here, then search both for the fact id or the old value.

status_legend.measured_live: Measured by the team on the live Cloud Run app and reported in the deck brief. No log of the run is committed to the repo; corroborating repo sources are listed where they exist.
status_legend.repo_code: Read directly from source code in this repo.
status_legend.repo_doc: Stated in a repo document (README, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, spikes, research).
status_legend.regulation_verified: Marked VERIFIED in docs/research/lda-regulations.md, which means read from an official LDA or Punjab government document.
status_legend.regulation_secondary: Marked SECONDARY in docs/research/lda-regulations.md (news or property portal). Say 'reported'.
status_legend.competitor_tested: Observed in the maket.ai teardown on the free tier, 16 Oct 2026 (docs/research/maket-teardown.md).
status_legend.in_progress: Specified in docs/OVERHAUL.md or docs/design/DESIGN.md, not yet confirmed live. Confirm on the live URL before exporting the PDF, or relabel it 'Shipping next'.
status_legend.proposal: A business or roadmap idea. Not validated, and not a commitment.
status_legend.qualitative: Framing without a measured number. Keep it qualitative on slides.
status_legend.unverified: No source. Do not state as fact.
status_legend.superseded: True when measured, but replaced on the slides by a newer live figure. Kept for history; do not use on slides.

asbuilt_check.claim: The as-built check confirms nothing in the 3D model projects into a mandatory open space beyond the chajja allowance: 3 ft where the open space is at least 10 ft, otherwise 1.5 ft, and 0 against a party wall.

retry_policy.claim: Shared-quota 429s and transient errors are retried with exponential backoff and jitter: 6 attempts, a 4 s initial delay, a 60 s maximum, base 2 and jitter 1.0, on status 408, 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504. The same policy is used by google-genai and the ADK Gemini model.

degenerate_guard.claim: Streamed JSON is watched for degenerate decoding: in the last 160 characters, 2 or fewer distinct characters, or a digit repeated 40 or more times (for example 35.0000000…). Either one aborts the attempt and retries it (2 attempts). Prompts also cap numbers at 2 decimal places.

lda_setbacks_10_30_marla.claim: In approved schemes, a 10–30 marla plot has 10 ft front, 7 ft rear and 5 ft side space on one side.

lda_storeys_3.claim: No plan may be approved above 3 storeys, excluding the basement, for any plot size (clause 2.7.1(a)).

lda_pcatp_stamp.claim: The plan must be prepared, stamped and signed by a PCATP-registered architect who is enlisted with LDA.

lda_penalty_open_space.claim: An open-space violation on the ground floor carries a penalty of Rs 500 per sq ft.

discrepancies_to_resolve: Approval wording: the live UI says 'Approval-ready' (compliance panel) and 'Plot to approval-ready plan' / 'LDA-ready design' (landing). The deck says 'pre-check'. Change the UI copy, or accept the mismatch.
Testing figures: the brief says 8 testers per round and about 200 fixes; the triage files list 160 tasks, and the round 2 and 3 triage files name 3 report files each.
Code sections: '23–25 sections' was measured on the 16 Oct samples and has not been recounted for the v3 samples.
Self-review image (slide 6): v2-backend-review-ground.png is a real drawing from api/app/agents/drawing.py, but of an earlier plan, not the v3 sample.

Cover and slide 5 renders (engine-argon-front, the stream thumbnails, the spike) show the first 10-marla house of 16 Oct, not the v3 sample. They are labelled as Argon's renders, not as the current sample.
Back-and-forth duration: README.md says 'months', and the deck brief says 'weeks'. Both are qualitative.
Runtime service account roles: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and SETUP.md list different roles. The deck names no roles.
